title: Fixed Side-Tip Curved Skip Wagon
description: One newly authored whole fixed side-tip skip wagon. A thick continuous curved-bottom tub has solid full endwalls and a true open top, shown tilted about longitudinal end trunnions supported by two complete end A-bearers. Open underframe, two axles, four flanged finite-facet wheels, axle hangers, fixed tub stops and end coupling faces complete one model. No imported hopper body or gate, and no old assembly merely rotated. Reference rail-family tread centre spacing only; origin at flange soles, tread bottoms above ground. One static visual model, zero scenes; no tipping motion, unloading, wheel or brake operation, coupling interoperability, rail fit, load, stability, engineering, manufacturing, occupancy or safety claim.
